configurePresets.name: native
configurePresets.displayName: Native x86 (SDL2, all five renderers, one binary)
configurePresets.description: 32-bit native build (needs a 32-bit SDL2). The full renderer set: NOpenGLESDrv, XOpenGLDrv, OpenGLDrv/UTGLR (system GL), SoftDrv and NullDrv. BUILD_STATIC links every package into one UnrealTournament binary: appGetDllHandle resolves through the internal UNREAL_STATIC registry instead of dlopen, and only system libraries (SDL2, libGL) and the bundled libopenal.so.1 stay dynamic. NOpenGLESDrv and XOpenGLDrv co-link because Thirdparty/glad_es carries a private symbol prefix. Builds in build-native/.

configurePresets.name: native64
configurePresets.description: 64-bit (LP64) native build: the same one-binary package set as `native`, compiled for x86_64 instead of -m32. Needs the amd64 SDL2 development files (libsdl2-dev) for the client; ucc-bin needs no SDL, GL or audio. Retail 32-bit .u packages run unchanged: script object references stay 4-byte slots holding the object index, and the reflected-class headers are pack(4). Builds in build-native64/.

configurePresets.name: android-arm64
configurePresets.displayName: Android arm64 -- the game as libUT99.so
configurePresets.description: The playable client as one shared library for arm64-v8a (SDL2 fetched and built shared beside it, openal-soft and libxmp static, XOpenGLDrv on GLES 3, OpenGLDrv/UTGLR through gl4es and NOpenGLESDrv on GLES 2, SoftDrv, NullDrv): the same configure the Gradle project in Android/ runs, for a build without the APK. Needs ANDROID_NDK_HOME. Builds in build-android-arm64-client/.

configurePresets.name: android-arm64-ucc
configurePresets.description: The dedicated server and commandlets as one Android executable (no SDL, no renderer, no audio, no APK): the 64-bit engine on an ARM device, run from adb shell. Needs ANDROID_NDK_HOME (e.g. ~/Android/Sdk/ndk/30.0.14904198). Builds in build-android-arm64/.

configurePresets.name: android-armv7-ucc
configurePresets.displayName: Android armv7 -- headless ucc-bin only, the 32-bit control
configurePresets.description: The same headless ucc-bin for armeabi-v7a: the 32-bit width control on the same ARM device. Builds in build-android-armv7/.

configurePresets.name: wasm
configurePresets.description: Emscripten web build: -O2 + DWARF + assertions. The everyday dev build: named stacks and readable errors at a playable speed. Builds in build-wasm/. Run `source <emsdk>/emsdk_env.sh` first (sets EMSDK).

configurePresets.name: wasm-debug
configurePresets.description: Emscripten web build: -O0, nothing inlined, every local live. For when the optimiser is the suspect: a bug that shows at one -O level and not another is almost always undefined behaviour. Builds in build-wasm-debug/.

configurePresets.name: wasm-perf
configurePresets.description: Emscripten shipping build: compiled at -O2, linked at -O3 -g0 without assertions, a symbol map beside the loader. Builds in build-wasm-perf/.

configurePresets.name: windows
configurePresets.description: 32-bit Windows build. Cross-compiles from Linux via the toolchain file (i686-w64-mingw32 + a fetched SDL2); the same preset works from an MSYS2 MINGW32 prompt, where pacman's SDL2 answers instead. BUILD_STATIC links every package into the exe: appGetDllHandle resolves through the internal registry, not LoadLibrary. Renderers: UTGLR (OpenGLDrv) and XOpenGLDrv, hardware GL through the system opengl32 (every entry point via SDL_GL_GetProcAddress, so nothing GL ships beside the exe), plus SoftDrv and NullDrv (CPU-only, so the build also runs headless under wine+Xvfb). Audio is NOpenALDrv (OpenAL Soft + libxmp); the build copies OpenAL32.dll next to the exe. BUILD_EDITOR is on: game content references Editor classes (bot meshes and skins). Builds in build-windows/.

configurePresets.name: windows64
configurePresets.description: The 64-bit twin of windows: x86_64-w64-mingw32 with the 64-bit SDL2 and OpenAL Soft builds (LLP64: long stays 4 bytes, pointers are 8). The shipped 32-bit .u packages run unchanged, as on native64. Builds in build-windows64/.
